sentences.text: Lina goes to a new school.
It is big, and she does not know many people.
She is from a different country, and everything feels new and strange.
She wants to make friends, but it is hard.
At twelve o'clock, it is time for lunch.
All the students sit together in the big cafeteria.
Lina finds a place to sit.
She opens her lunchbox.
Inside, her mom packed rice with chicken and vegetables.
It smells very good.
Lina loves her mom's food.
She looks at the other students.
They are eating sandwiches and apples.
A boy looks at her food and says something to his friend.
They laugh.
Lina feels sad.
Her face is hot.
She feels very different.
She quickly closes her lunchbox.
She is not hungry anymore.
That night, she talks to her mother.
“I don’t want this lunch,” Lina says quietly.
“The other children laugh.
I want a sandwich like them.”
Her mother sits next to her.
“Our food is part of our home,” she says.
“It is special because our family makes it with love.
You should be proud of it.”
Lina thinks about her mother's words.
The next day at school, she feels nervous at lunchtime.
She takes a deep breath and opens her lunchbox.
A girl with blonde hair named Chloe sits down.
“Hi,” Chloe says.
“What are you eating?
It smells delicious.”
Lina is surprised.
“It’s rice and chicken,” she says.
“It looks much better than my boring sandwich,” Chloe says and smiles.
“Can I try a little piece?”
Lina smiles back.
It is a big, happy smile.
“Yes, of course!” she says.
Chloe tries the food.
“Wow, this is great!” she says.
Lina feels warm and happy inside.
She eats all of her lunch.
Now, lunchtime is her favorite part of the day.
She has a new friend, and she is proud of her special lunch.
